title: A frame of a video comes out as a picture
goal: A recording open in the editor can now be exported as a video, and that took the other thing with it: there is no longer any way to get one frame out as a picture. Somebody wanting a still for a bug report, a slide or a thumbnail has to export the whole video and take a screenshot of it. Put a picture back on the same Export sheet, so one frame of what is on screen can leave as a PNG.
notes: Comes out of the 2026-09-21-video-export audit. Export on a timed document is now VideoExportDialog (Sources/Photonz/VideoExportDialog.swift) rather than ExportDialog, and the three formats are RecordingExport.formats. The frame itself is already available: EditorState.shownDocument is document.drawn(atTimeMS: documentTimeMS), so a still is previewRenderer.render(shownDocument, store:) through the existing ExportSizer path. The sheet is the place to add it, NOT a second sheet: the whole point of the video sheet is that a recording and a picture leave through the same one.
acceptance: Export on a document that has time offers a picture alongside MP4, GIF and HEIC, on the same sheet and in the same words
Picking it writes the frame the playhead is on, with everything drawn over it, at the document size
A document with no time is unaffected: the picture sheet is exactly what it is today
